nom: TULA Protect + Glow Daily Sunscreen Gel Broad Spectrum SPF 30

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the product as moisturizing and non-tacky, though several report peeling, burning, or drying out around the eyes and face after use.
segments.oily: A reviewer whose skin shifted from dry to oilier over time says the product still works well and keeps a glow without added shine; others note it doesn't leave skin looking oily or ashy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no burning, no irritation, and no breakouts, calling it gentle enough for daily use, but one sensitive-skin user experienced severe eye burning, stinging, drying and peeling.
segments.combination: A reviewer with normal-to-dry skin depending on the season says the product fits well into a layered routine but must be allowed to dry down fully before makeup.
segments.mature: A 45-year-old and a 43-year-old reviewer with long-term acne scarring and aging concerns both describe it as their go-to for a youthful glow with no new breakouts.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s report a visible glow and describe the product as part of an anti-aging routine, with one crediting it for a more youthful look on video calls; no reviewer reports it worsening fine lines or texture.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say it leaves skin feeling moisturized, soft, and hydrated without tackiness; a few report the opposite, describing dryness, peeling, and skin that took a week to recover.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers with reddish or uneven skin tone say the product reduced the look of redness and evened complexion; one reviewer reports the sunscreen itself caused burning and redness around the eyes.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report peeling, stinging, and eye-area burning severe enough to compromise the skin for about a week, contrasted with many others who report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne scarring say the product doesn't emphasize or worsen scarring and gives them confidence going without makeup; no reviewer reports it fading or targeting spots directly.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including those who identify as acne-prone, report zero new breakouts and no clogged pores over months or years of use; no reviewer in this set reports new breakouts from it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently say it doesn't feel greasy or heavy despite the dewy finish, though a handful describe the formula itself as greasy, chunky, or sitting on top of the skin like oil.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on deeper skin tones

extraits.titre: Never had sunscreen burns until now
extraits.texte: First time using was on a day i mowed my lawn so i thought maybe that caused the skin around my eyes to sting, burn, dry out & peel. After a weeklong battle to get my skin healthy again, i used this sunscreen again with the same results but worse...burning, stinging, dried skin near my eyes especially but all over my face that will now take at least a week to return to healthy by peeling off. Never again.

really really wanted to like this one but the eye burn was horrible. other than that I really liked how it was moisturizing but it wasn't tacky. I live in a humid climate and even though I generally have dry skin, a lot of moisturizing products feel tacky in the humidity. This stuff dried down beautifully and still left a glow. BUT THE EYE BURN T_T

I have tried many face sunscreens. A lot of them would burn my sensitive skin and make my eyes water, make my skin red, or leave a white cast. This stuff does none of those things! It doesnt even feel like Im wearing sunscreen, nor does it smell like sunscreen! It gives a beautiful, radiant glow to your skin. I get compliments all the time saying "wow your skin looks so good!" and "you have such a glow!" I used to be self conscious of my uneven, reddish skin tone and would only feel confident if I was wearing foundation or BB cream. Now i have ditched those products, and feel completely confident wearing only this product out because it gives such a radiant glow (its not sparkly, either). I have almost finished the jumbo bottle and plan to buy another one when all Tula products go on sale for 25% off on Sunday, which helps because it's pricey. Highly recommend!

This sunscreen has been a repeat for several years now. It's the only sunscreen that doesn't make me look ashy or oily. I have darker skin that is acne prone and this has been my Holy Grail. It gives me a beautiful glow while still offering protection. I love it. I can also use it with make out or alone for a flawless glow. My only con people be the smell, since it's a clean product, I noticed that there is a slight smell to it. Not horrible but it's there. It seems to fade after a while.

Let me paint a picture… I'm 45, been using this product for 5 years.. I've had acne prone skin for my entire life, so sometimes massive shiny skin emphasizes the size of these pores and accentuates my scarring, yes I have TERRIBLE acne scars.. but this product! Lemme tell you, It makes me feel my very best the moment I put it on my face, and neck. The perfect glow, and ZERO brake outs. This is by far the greatest dewy, shine bright like a diamond, moisturizer I've ever used! And I stand 10 toes down on every word i just wrote. Give this a try!!! If I doesn't work, y'all can return it.

My skin is normal to dry depending on the season. This product fits well in my routine. Cleanse, tone, moisturize, apply Tula sun screen and apply make up. Yes, this sunscreen is glowy. Yes, if you dont allow this product to dry down, it might not work as well. I hate dewy products. And, I likely would not use this product alone. I love the application and non-greasy feel, even after using moisturizer. Ill use another product if I'm going bare faced. Give it a try. I think you'll like it.
I wanted so badly to love this because i really like the brand. However, the formula is chunky and oily (like a lava lamp). Then once i applied it, my skin was peeling, dry and just gross.
